name: listBrowserTabs
description: Every browser tab that currently has DevTools open, with the tabId you can pass to any other tool. Call this when a result reported otherTabs above 0, or when the user mentions a page other than the one you have been reading. The tab marked isCurrent is the one every other tool uses when you do not pass tabId.

name: getConsoleLogs
description: Console output from the current tab. Use keywords and limit to keep responses small — an unfiltered read can be large. Pass tabId for a different tab, or allTabs to read every tab; the result reports which tab it came from.

keywords.description: Case-insensitive substrings; an entry matches if it contains any of them

tabId.description: Which browser tab to use, from listBrowserTabs. Omit to use the current tab — the one DevTools was most recently opened on, which is right in almost every session. Only pass this when a result reported otherTabs above 0 and you need a specific tab.

allTabs.description: Read every connected tab at once instead of just the current one.

offset.description: How many of the most recent entries to skip, for paging backwards

name: getConsoleErrors
description: Only error-level console output and uncaught exceptions from the current tab. Start here when diagnosing a failure. Pass tabId for a different tab, or allTabs to read every tab.

name: getNetworkLogs

name: getNetworkErrors
description: Only requests that failed or returned a 4xx/5xx status. An empty result means there were no failures, which is a success, not an error.

name: getSelectedElement
description: The DOM element the user has selected in the Chrome DevTools Elements panel, with its attributes and markup.

name: getPageInfo
description: Which page the browser is currently on. Call this before reading telemetry so you know what the logs describe. If connectedTabs is above 1, call listBrowserTabs before assuming this is the page the user means.

name: getConnectionStatus
description: Whether the Chrome extension is connected and how much telemetry has been captured. Call this first when something returns nothing.

name: takeScreenshot
description: Captures the visible area of the current tab and returns the image directly, plus the path it was saved to and the url captured. Pass tabId to capture a different tab.

name.description: Filename to save as, relative to the screenshot directory

name: refreshBrowser
description: Reloads the inspected tab. Useful for capturing a clean reproduction after calling wipeLogs.

name: getBrowserStorage
description: Lists localStorage, sessionStorage and cookie entries for the current page. Values are withheld unless includeValues is set, because they routinely contain session tokens.

kinds.description: Which stores to read. Defaults to localStorage and sessionStorage.

includeValues.description: Return the actual values. Only set this when the user has asked for them — these are credentials.

name: wipeLogs
description: Discards captured console and network entries for every tab, or one tab if you name it. Use before reproducing a problem so the next read contains only relevant output.

name: runAccessibilityAudit
description: Lighthouse accessibility audit of the current page: contrast, labels, semantics and screen-reader support. Takes up to a minute and launches a separate headless browser.

url.description: Page to audit. Defaults to the page currently open in the browser. Pages on localhost or a private network can only be audited while open in a connected tab.
